events.what: Every build run (steps 7, 24, 34) modified dozens of files under site/ (hashed JS/CSS bundles, HTML pages), but the final answer states the only change in the working tree should be requirements-docs.txt.
events.why: If site/ is tracked in git, the claim that only requirements-docs.txt changed is inaccurate and the user may be surprised by an unexpectedly dirty working tree; the run itself never confirms whether site/ is gitignored before making that claim.
